description_en: Sends card messages to multiple recipients in a batch
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-batch-card-sms --card-template-code CARD_SMS_3005 --fallback-type SMS --phone-number-json 13900000000_,_13700000000 --sign-name-json '阿里云_,_阿里巴巴' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendBatchCardSms

parameters.help_en: The code of the card message template. On the Card Message Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page in the console, select a card message template code that has passed the review
parameters.help_zh: 卡片短信模板Code。请在控制台卡片短信模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面选择已通过审核的卡片短信模板Code
parameters.name: card_template_code

parameters.help_en:
The code of the fallback text message template. This parameter is required when FallbackType is set to SMS for fallback to text messages.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html operation to query templates applied for under the current account, or view the template list in the SMS Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template).
The template must be added and approved
parameters.help_zh:
回落文本短信的模板Code。FallbackType选择SMS回落文本短信时，此参数必填。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html接口查询当前账号已申请的模板或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)查看模板列表。
必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信模板
parameters.name: sms_template_code

parameters.help_en:
The fallback type. Valid values:
SMS: Falls back to text messages for phone numbers that do not support card messages.
DIGITALSMS: Falls back to digital messages for phone numbers that do not support card messages.
NONE: No fallback is required
parameters.help_zh:
回落类型。取值：
SMS：不支持卡片短信的号码，回落文本短信。
DIGITALSMS：不支持卡片短信的号码，回落数字短信。
NONE：不需要回落
parameters.name: fallback_type

parameters.help_en:
The code of the fallback digital message template. This parameter is required when FallbackType is set to DIGITALSMS for fallback to digital messages.

You can view the digital message template list on the Domestic Digital Message Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/digit) page in the console.
The template must be added and approved
parameters.help_zh:
回落数字短信的模板Code。FallbackType选择DIGITALSMS回落数字短信时，此参数必填。

您可在控制台国内数字短信模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/digit)页面查看数字短信模板列表。
必须是已添加、并通过审核的数字短信模板
parameters.name: digital_template_code

parameters.help_en: The ID reserved for the caller
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The phone numbers to receive the messages
parameters.name: phone_number_json

parameters.help_en:
The signature names for the messages.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html operation to query signatures applied for under the current account, or view the signature list in the SMS Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign).
The signatures must be added and approved. The number of signatures must be the same as the number of phone numbers, and they must correspond one-to-one
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名名称。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html接口查询当前账号已申请的签名或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)查看签名列表。
必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信签名；且短信签名的个数必须与手机号码的个数相同、内容一一对应
parameters.name: sign_name_json

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the variables in the card message template. This parameter is required when the CardTemplateCode card message template contains variables.

If the JSON contains line breaks, process them according to the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信模板参数对应的实际值。CardTemplateCode卡片短信模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。

如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: card_template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the variables in the text message template. This parameter is required when the SmsTemplateCode fallback text message template contains variables.

If the JSON contains line breaks, process them according to the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文本短信模板参数对应的实际值。SmsTemplateCode回落的文本短信模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。

如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: sms_template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the variables in the digital message template. This parameter is required when the DigitalTemplateCode fallback digital message template contains variables.
If the JSON contains line breaks, process them according to the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
数字短信模板参数对应的实际值。DigitalTemplateCode回落的数字短信模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。
如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: digital_template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The code of the custom content template.

The custom content is sent to the terminal in the format of the selected text message template plus the card parsing link. Log on to the SMS Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/overview), select Domestic Messages or International/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan Messages, and view the Template CODE on the Template Management page.

The template must be added and approved. When sending international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages, use the corresponding international message template.
For example, if the selected text message template content is: You have a message to view, and the card parsing link is: `1*.cn/2**d`, the final delivered content is: `You have a message to view 1*.cn/2**d`. Test and control the character count before sending
parameters.help_zh:
自定义发送内容模板CODE。

自定义内容会按照选定的文本短信模板+卡片解析链接的形式下发到终端，您可以登录短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/overview)，选择国内消息或国际/港澳台短信，在模板管理页面查看模板CODE。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信模板；且发送国际/港澳台消息时，请使用国际/港澳台短信模板。
例如：选择的文本短信模板内容为：您有一条消息待查收；卡片解析链接为：`1*.cn/2**d`。最终下发内容：`您有一条消息待查收1*.cn/2**d`。请在下发前做好测试和字数控制
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the variables in the custom content template. This parameter is required when the TemplateCode contains a message template with variables.

If the JSON contains line breaks, process them according to the standard JSON protocol.
The number of template variable values must be the same as the number of phone numbers and signatures, and they must correspond one-to-one. This indicates that the message with the corresponding signature is sent to the specified phone number, and the variables in the message template are replaced with the corresponding values
parameters.help_zh:
自定义发送内容模板变量对应的实际值。TemplateCode填入包含变量的短信模板时，此参数必填。

如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理；
模板变量值的个数必须与手机号码、签名的个数相同、内容一一对应，表示向指定手机号码中发对应签名的短信，且短信模板中的变量参数替换为对应的值
parameters.name: template_param_json

CardTmpState.description_en:
The review status of the card message template. Valid values:
0: Under review.
1: Approved.
2: Rejected.
Messages with rejected templates can be configured with a fallback process by using the FallbackType field
CardTmpState.description_zh:
卡片短信模板审核状态。取值：
0：审核中。
1：审核通过。
2：审核不通过。
审核不通过的短信可通过FallbackType字段设置回落流程
